note: Mapping corrections for the Stage C Germanic tables (menota, icepahc, rea-goh, rea-osx), Phase 8c. 'lemma' rows: as in the other override files (applied by formula_search_multi.apply_* and, inside pie/germanic_new_mapping.py, to each '|' alternative of a lemma string). 'proto' rows: corrections of a Proto-Germanic / Proto-West-Germanic term, applied by germanic_new_mapping.BaseResolver while the tables are built (every daughter word whose chain passes the term). No 'form' rows (these corpora are lemmatized). Each row cites its dictionary; see docs/research/mapping-precision-germanic-new.md.
